turns.question: What share of our orders on 1 and 2 October 2026 was cancelled?
turns.answer: 16.7% of the orders placed on 1 and 2 October 2026 were cancelled (cancellation rate, 0.167 as a share of orders, for 1-2 October 2026). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: How did you calculate that rate?
turns.answer: The metric is defined as: "Share of orders cancelled." The query counted orders with status cancelled and divided them by all orders placed on 1 and 2 October 2026, counting each order on the day it was placed.
